title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：sister　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sister 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the grandmother ① taught the sister that no child in the courtyard would have described, and he said the teaching was the whole of the year. The ② sister, meaning the sibling itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a sister, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sister in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ sister at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sister, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the grandmother said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sister was the whole of the matter, meaning the company and not the sibling. The ⑥ sister, meaning the company and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; sister, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a sibling and a company. He said the company is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ sister had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ sister of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of describing; sister, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sister I remember is the sibling described in the diary, which closed in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ sister, my mother said in 1969, is the only sibling that improves by being described; every sister, she said, is a company that has agreed to look like a sibling. She said the company was the honest half.

options: A. n. 姐妹（指院子里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 姐妹（指那位姐妹本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the sister 教这一位姐妹

F. n. 姐妹（指日记里写到、被描述的那一位）
G. n. 姐妹、陪伴（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: teach the sister 意为“教这一位姐妹”，1960 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯描述的一位姐妹做了一遍。
sister 意为“姐妹”，指那位姐妹本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
sister 意为“姐妹”，指院子里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
sister 意为“姐妹”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sister 意为“姐妹、陪伴”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位陪伴就是那件事的全部。
sister 意为“陪伴”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位姐妹，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sister 意为“姐妹”，指日记里写到、被描述的那一位，到 1965 年这一位成了日记里的一行。
sister 意为“姐妹之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的姐妹之事是一处院子和三个年头的描述。
sister 意为“姐妹”，我记得的是日记里描述过的那一位，1967 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一位。
sister 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，姐妹是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的姐妹。
